notes.title: Take My Hand 🤝🦍
notes.content:
Ever needed a helping hand or just wanted to try something new with your fellow Monke?

Introducing [b]Take My Hand[/b] a new way to cooperate, experiment, and create monkey chains of pure chaos (or teamwork, depending on your vibe).

Here’s what you can do with it:

- Can’t quite reach that branch? A friend can lean down and pull you up!
- Your friends stuck at the beach? Reach down and haul them out!
- Facing a tricky long jump? Someone can reach out and grab you mid-leap!
- Want to form a Monke chain across the Forest? One Monke grabs a branch, another grabs their hand, and another grabs [i]their[/i] hand... you get the idea.

Unlike Guardian, there’s no forced grabbing here. If you don’t want to hold hands, just let go of grip! Easy as that.

We hope this brings new fun, exploration, and very silly moments to your Monke life.

Now go out there and Take Someone’s Hand! ✋🦧

notes.title: 📈Ranked Mode is Here!
notes.content:
One of the most requested features over the years is finally becoming reality.

This is our take on skill-based matchmaking for competitive minded players. It’s not meant to replace  amazing community leagues like GTC they’re still the gold standard for serious organized play, but it offers a low-pressure, built-in way to test yourself, improve, and climb the ladder.

No signups, no spreadsheets - just jump in, tag, and climb through the ranks. You will find it located in the City Competitive Course.

🏆 How it works:

- We’ll be starting with 1 map daytime-only Forest, no seasonal set dressing, so the map stays [b]consistent[/b] for competitive play.
- Ranked uses [b]MMR[/b]-based matchmaking to match you with similarly skilled players.
- PC players will only match with PC, and Quest with Quest.
- Matches start with [b]4 or more[/b] players.
- [b]Timed[/b] infection rounds keep the pace tight.
- [b]Welcoming[/b] for newcomers, with plenty of room for grinders to rise and shine.

🎖️ Want to show off your achievements?

You can pick up the [b]Ranked Cosmetic Pack[/b], which displays your current rank in-game:

- On [b]Quest[/b], it appears as a [b]belt[/b]
- On [b]PC[/b], it’s shown as a [b]ring[/b]

Climb the ladder from [b]Wood, Rock, Bronze, Silver, Gold[/b], and [b]Beyond[/b]! Every match helping define your skill. You can skip Wood and Rock if you unlock Competitive Course -  it’s all in your hands.

🔥 [b]But that’s not all![/b] 🔥

[b]Monke go Boom[/b] this 4th July with the new [b]Fire Fanatic Pack![/b]

Light up the lobby with [b]three explosive exclusives[/b]:

- [b]Party Payload[/b]
- [b]Uncle Blam Jacket[/b]
- [b]Mark One Mitts[/b]
- [b]10,000 Shiny Rocks[/b].

This pack is available for a [b]limited time[/b], but may return in the future. Don’t miss it while it’s hot

notes.title: Nowruz Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39711486/1661f5f1b0ffef4abab95917bbcf5b8642ac8500.png[/img]

The Forest is brimming with new life! The flowers are blooming, the bees are buzzing, and the monkes are celebrating! Help pollinate the Forest and experience the joy of Spring with the Nowruz update!

Nowruz, or "new day" in Persian, is a festival that marks the beginning of spring and celebrates the rebirth of nature. It begins on the vernal equinox, when the sun crosses the equator. This year, Nowruz falls on March 20th. It is celebrated by more than 300 million people all around the world and has been celebrated for over 3,000 years in the Balkans, the Black Sea Basin, the Caucasus, Central Asia, the Middle East and other regions.

notes.title: Holiday 2023 Update

notes.title: The Fall Update is Here!

notes.title: Halloween 2022 Flashback Update

Some monkes love tricks, other monkes love treats!

notes.title: Halloween 2023 Update

There’s plenty of fun and frights waiting for you, so get your friends together for a bone-chilling good time! Swing your way to the treetops and avoid the lava monkes to safely escape the incoming heat. Or if swimming in lava sounds more fun, jump on in and try to bring everyone down with you. The heat is not limited to just the forest; the city shop is stocked full of fiery new accessories to gear up before you challenge the volcano. There’s scorched clothes, heat-proof suits, and flame covered everything so you can look as hot as the lava below!

notes.title: Back to School Update

notes.title: Summer Splash Update!

notes.title: Halloween Update 2022
notes.content:
## Halloween Update 2022

Happy Halloween, Everyone!

This is one of the team's favorite holidays in the year and we want to invite you to come celebrate with us.  The spirits have come to play and have changed everything!

Explore Every Nook and Cranny

Every map has been updated to celebrate the season.  Discover hidden secrets and new routes through fields of skeletons, jack-o-lanterns, bubbling cauldrons, and giant webs stretching across the sky.  We've had a blast updating the world and can't wait for the updates to come.

Halloween = Costumes

New costume sets and items with special surprises to help you celebrate the holiday your way.  What are you looking at poor Yorick?  Did you make a new friend that you found in your web-rella?  It's friendly!  Don't set it on fire with the new demonic Deadshot slingshot.  Grab your Unicorn and ride off in a trail of sparkles.

My Balloon!

We are very excited to be releasing the balloons feature.  This is a brand new type of cosmetic that is an example for how we plan to expand on the core game mechanics in the future.  Grab it off of your back and set it free.  Bat it around and play a game of keepy-uppy.  Release them into the air and see who can shoot them down.  Get a group together and set up your own target gallery and challenge each other to see who can make the hardest shots.

A huge thank-you to all of our players for your support.  We hope you have as much fun playing as we had making this update for you.

Special Thanks to StyledSnail (https://www.youtube.com/c/StyledSnail) and our alpha community for taking this picture for the update.

notes.title: Paintbrawl!
notes.content:
Paint Brawl update is out now!

Jump back in and try out the new team slingshot mode
Paint Brawl is a new team battle mode using your slingshot to eliminate other players after their balloons are popped.  After you're out of the round, help your team by stunning the other players!

All new cosmetics to customize your Paint Brawl look
New items in the store including vests and masks inspired by Paint Brawl, the knightly Cardboard Armor Set, and the crazy Rockin Mohawk.  Plus, get an early look at what we're working on next in the coming soon section!

New ways to hold and store your items
We have big plans for how you'll use your hands for new features coming in the future - so we are making a big change to how the holdable items work in this patch.  We are updating the system to now allow you to carry up to 4 different items at one time. The new holdable locations are one on each arm and one behind each shoulder. We know this is a big change and we're listening to your feedback.

Build Notes

Paint Brawl September 2022
* Paintballs match your team colors
* Balloons match your team colors
* Health bar shown on slingshot handle
* Particle trails for paintballs
* Paintball splash effect on impact
* Visual screen effects when you are hit
* Arm collision now counts as a hit
* Dockable Cosmetics
     * Smaller Items dock to your forearms
     * Larger Items dock to your shoulders
* Interactable Targets placed throughout the maps
* New Paintball related cosmetics and Wearables added
* Team Battle Mode = Paint Brawl
* Infinite bubble fix for bubble gun
* Changes to city map to improve performance

notes.title: Summer Update
notes.content:
Thanks again for everyone's patience. Summer is (finally) here! Check out some of the new seasonal cosmetics! Just make sure you don't spend too much time in the sun and get burned!

There's also a beta available for a new game mode: Battle! Using your paintball slingshot, take out all the other gorillas! Last one with any balloons left wins! Note that this is still an early beta, and it is nowhere near done yet. It will be available for a few days, since I mostly want to do some testing and feedback over how well the game mode works, how fun it is, and any tweaks it needs before I finish polishing it. It will only be available for a few days, then I'll take it down again so I can continue working on it.

Known issues with the beta:
-all handheld items except the slingshot are disabled. I'm working on a more elegant system for this.
-you can only change the hand you're holding the slingshot with by pressing the Battle button with different hands. This is going to be worked on. If it doesn't change hands correctly, try restarting
-slingshot doesn't move on other players
-none of the graphics and effects are final

notes.title: Guitar Update
notes.content:
The rest of the music update is here! New guitars have been added, it's time to wave them around and bash some notes on them maybe. It's also getting more summery, so the leaves have changed to green, and there's a new campfire to enjoy, as well as a new song that plays in the forest at night.

There are also a few smaller changes - you can no longer hear instruments played by players you've muted, and there's a new ITEM menu on the computer (previously was for changing cosmetics particles), where you can enable or disable particles on items or change the volume of instruments for other players.

notes.title: Music Update
notes.content: There are some new Music cosmetics available in the store, including a few sets of drums! I'm trying something new, so this is taking me a little longer than I expected. There'll be some more stuff available soon!

notes.title: New Time of Day!
notes.content:
I felt like things were getting a little samey, so now there's a new time of day in the game. Lemme know what you think!

There are also a few other bug fixes, most notably fixing a lot of the glitches that let people escape the maps. It's not totally fixed, but things should be a lot better. If I need to make more changes in the future, I will.

Patch Notes:
made it more difficult to escape the map
fixed bug with computer showing wrong color screen sometimes
changed time of day
fixed some bugs with geo and sounds
standardized more of the textures

notes.title: Performance Update
notes.content: There's a new update! It didn't change much in the actual game, but performance should be a lot better, especially for anyone who was having frame issues in City or Forest. In the course of making these changes, some of the textures look a little different. To be honest I'm not really sure why, it's all the same images, just arranged differently.

notes.title: Full Spring Patch!
notes.content:
Spring is fully here! The rest of the Spring cosmetics are now in the store, and the cherry blossoms have bloomed! Check it out!

You can now, finally, hold items in your hands separately from the badge slot! You can also hold one item in each hand (except the items that already apply to both hands), and you can switch hands you're holding items with. Have fun!

The slippery surfaces have also been adjusted a bit. You have a little less directional control on fully slippery surfaces (previously, you could change your direction by about 33% every second, and now you can only do about 20%). The slippery walls in the other maps have also changed back to using some older logic for movement, but there's a new higher band on Forest that is fully slippery.

notes.title: (Tiny) Gorilla Tag Anniversary Update! Hooray!!!!
notes.content:
I can't believe it's been a year already, I really can't. Thanks so much to everyone who played the game, who shared it, who made cool fanart, and who ran around screaming "monke." It's been a crazy year, and I really don't have much else to say but thank you!

I've been really busy with some updates that you might have some clues about from some of the betas and leaks. I hope you'll understand that there's just a small update for the anniversary. Check out the city for a few free gifts!

Also fixed a bug with muting the audio in caves and canyon

notes.title: Winter Update
notes.content:
It's day again in Gorilla World! But it's still cold, so stay warm with some of the new winter cosmetics. Everyone gets some rosy cheeks for the season!

The canyon and cave have changed a bit. I hope you like the changes!

notes.title: Holiday Update!
notes.content:
It's winter in Gorilla World!!!! Hooray my favorite season!!!

-removed fall cosmetics
-added holiday/new year cosmetics
-it's winter now!
-improved movement logic to make it harder to glitch through objects
-added fix for bug where if one of the regions were down, it would stop you from joining any games

notes.title: Fix for City Escape Glitch
notes.content: Fixed the spot people were using to escape the map in city. Only a temporary fix until I can fix the underlying locomotion so you can't phase through objects under certain conditions

notes.title: Boring Update
notes.content: Wow, so many patch notes, this sucks! Anyway, I made some changes that will make disconnecting using option 1 a little less laggy (it's still laggy I'm working on it), and made some changes that will hopefully help against the attack that causes dead flying gorillas

notes.title: Whoops Bad Build Hotfix!!!
notes.content: There was an issue with haptics! I think I messed up the build settings, this one should be better

notes.title: Network Tuneup Patch
notes.content:
Not too many changes on the front end, but there are some pretty heavy to changes to how some things are handled on the back end. This is necessary for some updates coming soon, as well as helping stamp out a few bugs.

-update to some of the networking logic, this will be necessary for some changes coming down the line
-added a game mode selector, removed the "casual" queue
-fix for some issues with gorillas having incorrect skin
-hopefully a fix for the last person being tagged out of nowhere bug

notes.title: Fall 2.0 hotfix
notes.content: whoops haha the new cosmetics weren't showing up for other players (don't worry, purchasing wasn't affected so no info there got messed up). that's fixed now sorry!!

notes.title: Fall Update!
notes.content:
Just a small update today, Halloween is over and it's now Fall in Gorilla World!

-removing temporary halloween store
-change time to sunrise
-it's now fall in the forest
-added two reskinned hats for early access dlc owners

notes.title: COSMETICS UPDATE!
notes.content:
Wow this one is a doozy, and feels like a long time coming! I've been working pretty hard at it, so hopefully you all enjoy it.

There's now a new City area with a shopping center where you can buy cosmetics. Everyone starts with 500 Shiny Rocks, and every day you log in you'll get 100 more to spend. You can also purchase additional currency at the ATM.

Sorry, I don't have too much of a big fancy post to go along with this, I've been working on getting things ready pretty much all last week day and night. I hope you'll log in and check it out, I think it's super dope!

notes.title: Music Patch!!!
notes.content:
There is now music in the Forest! It only plays every so often, so stick around until it starts playing! I think you'll like it.

Not a giant patch, but I think the music is very great.

- added a song to the forest that plays every so often
- fixed some issues with the afk kick
- fixed some bad geo in caves that was making it easy to exploit
- fixed a bug on quest that was making the lighting wacky, so decreased the brightness on pc a bit since it was set too high to make sure the quest lighting looked ok
- added an admin badge only for admins, to prove who they are (i'm the only admin lol). so if someone says they're an admin and they don't have the badge, they're lying!

notes.title: Perf Patch
notes.content:
Another small patch today.

-fixed some issues with a memory leak that was calling garbage collection extremely often. this fix should help a lot with frame drops
-fixed bug where sometimes you would get tagged randomly when a new player joins the room

notes.title: Security Patch
notes.content:
Another relatively small patch, but this has a few changes mostly targeted towards reducing the impact of hackers (I think the reporting system has been pretty good about this overall, but there are a few potential nasty issues that I wanted to take care of before they could get out of control):

-protection against certain kinds of hacks that could freeze or launch you into the air
-no more neon colors
-removed long names with non-alphanumeric characters
-name length increased to 12 characters
-improved some performance relating to the scoreboards

I know the last few patches haven't been very big, but thanks for bearing with me. I've been going pretty full tilt since release, and it's been difficult keeping up that schedule alongside my full time job. I'm going to keep doing my best, and hopefully things will pick up again. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Sound Update!
notes.content:
A few things here and there, but the biggest thing is that now there are different sounds when you tap different surfaces, and the different regions have some ambient audio that will make it feel a little cooler to just be there bouncing around.

-added a message of the day board to show messages and game update info
-added ambient sounds to different regions
-modified player volume and volume compression
-added different sounds when hitting different surfaces
-added particles to rock gorilla
-fixed issue with joining pub rooms as a group
-fixed an exploit to escape playable area
-updated some networking to make cosmetics work a little more efficiently

notes.title: Casual Queue Update
notes.content:
Relatively small update, but has a few goodies in it:

- casual queue (set it at the computer, has no tag/infection going on, so just hang out)
- added slippery walls along the top rim of the forest cliffs to prevent people from camping up high and escaping the map
- less aggressive afk kick
- hopefully a fix for join as group (or at least an improvement)
- more granular reports (you can now specify hate speech, toxicity, and cheating)
- moved some of the cliffs around and straightened some out

notes.title: Early Access Cosmetics Update!
notes.content:
-initial support for cosmetics! currently, the DLC is only available on steam. i can't sell any dlc yet on quest, so people playing there will have to wait. i appreciate your patience on this, i'm working on it!

-revamped the computer. now you change tabs with an up and down button on the left side of the keyboard

-added a new group tab. this will let you join pub matches together with other players. while in a private room, gather everyone you want to join together next to the computer. then, choose either the forest or cave map with the option buttons. then press enter, and you'll all b
e brought into a new room together.

-added a new queue, competitive, for people looking for more of a challenge. go to the computer, go to the queue tab, then press option 2 to select it! by default, players start in the default queue. you can go back to it by selecting option 1

-added an icon on the scoreboard that appears next to the name of someone when they're talking, this should make it easier to figure out who's speaking at any given time

-added push to talk/push to mute options for the mic

-added a new upper room for the cosmetics. it includes a mirror so you can marvel at your new look. flashy!

-fixed the slow fall bug that happened if you used smooth locomotion and constantly rotated as you fell

-updated the Photon integration, hopefully this will fix some issues where people are having trouble connecting when they're behind certain types of networks

-added a new path to the mines from the crystal cavern in the cave level. there should now be a more natural transition from the two areas available. i might do a similar thing on the opposite side of the cave, please let me know what you think

-fixed an issue where if you disconnected ungracefully, like through being afk or getting kicked by photon because your connection was unstable, you could no longer join any rooms. now even if that happens, you should be able to join a room like normal

-fixed an issue where your account wouldn't authenticate correctly on the back end. this was causing problems with reports, they should now be much more consistent

-added some background checks that should make rooms more stable and make it more difficult for them to end up in a state where nobody could get tagged and the round wouldn't end

notes.title: Early Access Supporter Pack update!!!
notes.content:
Hey guys! This patch took a little longer to get out than I wanted, so thanks for bearing with me. I’m still learning a lot about the game development process, so I’ve been trying to take things a bit slowly and carefully. There were some issues with the way I was validating cosmetics, so it turns out to be lucky that it took me a little bit longer, since if I had released this late last week, there’s a good chance it would have exploded immediately. There’s still a good chance it will explode right now. I really hope that doesn’t happen!

This patch includes initial support for cosmetics. I think they look pretty great! I wouldn’t exactly consider myself an artist, but I’m really pleased with how they turned out. I hope you guys like them too! Right now, this is not available on native quest; that is, you can see other people wearing the cosmetics, but you won’t be able to buy them yourself. There are some technical limitations behind this, namely that right now, I can’t directly sell add ons for money on App Labs. I don’t want to create a parallel account system in order to support that, since I’d need to build out a way to create a separate account, validate your purchase, and hook it up to your Quest somehow, none of which I already know how to do (so I’d need to learn), and this would take a huge amount of time and effort, which I’d rather spend working on the game directly. I’m hoping this will become possible sooner rather than later, so I really appreciate your patience.

There’s also a bunch of QOL changes in this update, like push to talk/push to mute, a little speaker icon next to your name when you’re talking, a new queue, ways to join matches with your friends, and more. For details, please read all the patch notes. Basically, with this patch I’m hoping that I can keep working on a lot of the rough edges currently in the game. I want to make it a more smooth process for people to play the game the way they want, including trying to make it easier for good players to play against other good players, and everyone to be able to play with their friends more easily.

As for what’s next, now that the App Labs version is out, I’m hoping that it will be easier for me to do some more consistent, smaller patches, since it should be much less of a pain in the butt to get the game updated. Right now, I’m working on some more granular reporting (so you can be more specific as to whether your report is about someone being bigoted, or cheating, or harassing certain players, or griefing lobbies, things like that), so it isn’t one big catch-all. I’m also working on a new canyon map that’s going to focus more on wall jumps, I’m really excited for it and I think it’ll be super cool.

All that said, I have one bad piece of news. I’m unfortunately currently stuck in a hotel in quarantine. I’ve had a pretty big family issue crop up, and while I don’t want to get into details for personal reasons, I thought it would only be fair to let you guys know that it’s going to impact my ability to get stuff out. I brought everything I need to keep working on the game, so I’m still going to be doing that, but I thought I’d let you guys know because it’s going to slow me down. I really appreciate all the support you’ve given me so far in terms of playing and sharing the game, and I’m really excited about the future of the game, but at the end of the day family comes first. I’m hoping everything turns out ok and things can get back to normal soon. Thanks for your understanding, and I hope you enjoy the patch!

notes.title: Cave Map Patch
notes.content:
-new map! instead of just walking outside, you can now go down inside the dead tree. i wonder where the tunnel came from?

-with the new map, the behavior of the game will change a little bit. if you're in a public room, each room will be limited to certain areas. you can always return to the tree to change settings and stuff, but if you're in a room in the forest and go to the cave, you will join a new room to play in the cave. if you're in the cave and you leave the tree and go into the forest, you will join a new room in the forest. this way, each playable area is restricted to a reasonable size. if you're in a private room, you can go anywhere in the map without changing rooms, but i recommend setting some house rules to constrain yourself to a specific area to make it more fun.

-there's a new board in the tree room with the gorilla code of conduct on it. it outlines what behavior is appropriate and what isn't. if someone isn't being a cool gorilla and making sure everyone feels welcomed and comfortable, please report them! i will not stand for people being racist, sexist, bigoted, homophobic, transphobic, or anything else like that. i really like banning those people, so please press the report button next to their name and let me know what happened in the discord!

-unfortunately, since a lot of people have thought that they could away with behaving inappropriately and breaking the rules, i added a ban message reason along with counter for how many hours are left until the ban expires. if your ip is banned and you're playing on a different headset, then it will just say that your ip has been banned. there's currently no way to get the reason and time left unless it's from the banned headset.

-fixed bug where snap and smooth turn would launch you randomly. please let me know if there are still any remaining issues

-fixed bug where if you leave a room while tagged/infected and join a new room, you still appear as the tagger or infected even when you aren't

-updated the forest map walls to make it a little bit more difficult to escape the map. too many people were trolling by becoming uncatchable. it's still not impossible, but it should be less easy.

-updated the branches sticking out of the dead tree to be a ramp. this will make it easier for new players to make it up to the computer where they can change their settings.

-added 4 random digits to the default gorilla name so each player will be distinguishable from the start.
